## Design decisions (this row's)

- **`0 14 15-17 * *` over G3's `0 14 15 * *` sketch.** The ticket's
  verbatim window — "first weekday on/after the 15th" — can only land on
  a 15th/16th/17th; the trigger wakes each candidate and the evaluator
  suppresses non-first-weekdays. The suppression rule is a recorded
  check on every evaluation, never a comment.
- **Suppression reads the journal, not the clock.** The Class S lookback
  derives from the `promoted` event's recorded `class` + `recorded_at` —
  a fact off the append-only journal; `latest.json`'s `class` agrees but
  the journal is the history.
- **The evaluator is the shared drift half.** `evaluate` is the one
  function P36.43's status lane names — one rule set, never two.
- **`no_release` is honest.** No `latest.json` ⇒ no promotion history ⇒
  nothing to suppress on and nothing to age — the record says
  `no_release`; the first cut stays the operator's ACT-24 leg.
- **Exit 6 on a fired alert** — `alerts.alert_exit_code` parity with the
  probe/diff verbs; the ledger write stands even when no notifier is
  configured.
